profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary: I have achieved Master of Computer Science graduate from Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago.Currently working in Intuit, as a Senior Software Engineer. A proficient engineer with analysis knowledge of software design process, configuration and implementation of hardware and Carve a career in computer Systems leveraging acquired skills in interface  Development. Good team player and a strong believer in teamwork and performance..Efficient in solving complex issues.Ability to work and taking initiative as a individual as well as in team. A Technocrat , as I love working on various different technologies Worked on every part of Software Development Business Cycle from Collecting Requirement to Delivery of product

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Planning, designing, and developing cloud-based applications.
Managing cloud environments like AWS, GCP in accordance with company security guidelines.
Deploying and debugging cloud initiatives and Building and designing web services in the cloud platforms.
Using your extensive knowledge of APIs to design RESTful services in Python,
Automating deployment and releases through CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer ecosystem automation
positions.description:
Working on developing a RESTful API to deploy and configure Teradata database and ecosystem applications systems on various environments, storage arrays, and switches.
 Working on programming tasks including enhancements, maintenance, and support for clients’ applications and interfaces

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building, configuring and deploying VIA (Virtual Infrastructure Architecture), Managing existing deployed VIA Wifi Servers using virtual box, vsphere, worked on Linux, Ubuntu, Centos. 
•     Working on distributed systems, web infrastructure and protocols, network architectures and distributed transaction processing
•     Creating RESTful API Venue Management system for deployment, configuration, management of new and old venues. 
•     Creating VCC Venue Control center, a dashboard for existing venues, dashboard currently monitors and logs data for 30 venues, it is highly available and used for network monitoring.
•     One of the Lead members of VIA SWAT Team, responsible to deploy and monitor multiple venues. Provide 24/7 support. 
•     Automated the configuration process using Venue Management system.
•     Technologies used: Node js, React, Redux, Swagger, Angular, Mongodb, Postgresql, Linux, Ansible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
 Working in Connectors team, Responsible to build new connectors using Java and client API.
 Used API’s like google Adwords, Instagram, Facebook etc, to get information and generate report 
and stats based on it.
 Developed a web scrapper using Web Client tools.
 Coded authentication logic for RESTFull API’s and also worked on Oauth 2.0 protocol.
 Responsible to manage, resolve bugs and add new functionality to existing connectors.
 Designed and implemented optimal data solutions for Web analytics and Hue editor.
 Developed tools in java to support current systems.
 Consistently worked to improve the processes and quality of our team's work by: implementing 
test-driven development, ensuring that software conformed to architectural standards and 
participating in design and implementation reviews.
 Researched and created technical document on the clients’ requirement and API availability.
 Practiced writing clean code that adheres to a coding standard with help of few tools, Checkstyle, 
UCDetector.
 Technologies : Java 8, PostgresSQL, Mongodb,

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
1. Managing Lab with 30 systems and server maintenance.
2. Troubleshooting of printers , scanners, computers.
3. Install/configure new computer, upgrade computers with software & hardware.
4. Track new and old equipment and schedule maintenance when required

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Working on Virtual Technical university project. Various Kind of technology were identify to develop this project communication from web based portal to field device was done with the help of Open source MODBUS Protocol which is implemented in java given as JAMODBUS API, System is capable for providing screen sharing, Live video transmission of field device using Red5 Server.
•	Working on Java, Hibernate, Spring framework , MySQL , Mongo db.
•	performing Remote Method Invocation call From server to Desktop and using Comet Programming (Push – Pull Technologies) to update data on PLC circuit.
•	Developing an application for PLC(Programmable logic controller),DCS(Distribute Control System) with Hardware communication using java , MongoDB , JSON , HTML5 ,CSS3,JQuery , BackBone.js,Unerscore.js. 
•	Chat Server application along with the Live Lecture Streaming using red5 server.
•	Notification generation system and email server.
•	Evaluation system (online test conduction) & certificate Generation.

positions.title: Software Trainee
positions.description:
Working On Virtual Laboratory on Client Side. Responsible for smooth going and review of project on weekly bases, interacting with client for increasing productivity of project
--Working on Virtual Lab designed different simulator for various engineering branch which include simulating various sensor like LVDT, Strain Gauge, Capacitance, Distributed Control System, PLC, Bio-Medical Lab, Electrical Lab, etc.
--Working on UI design using CSS3, HTML5 and functionality using JavaScript and its various framework like jQuery, Moo-tool. Back-end is done using Java that will be used to store state of user, storing result in database.
--All these simulator run on top of Guzool Platform.Handled everything from Collecting and understanding requirement from various department of engineering and converting them into technical details, POC, Prototyping, Developing, Testing, Deploying.
--Learned how to use Guzool Platform to develop application.

positions.title: Java Trainee
positions.description:
--Worked on Java technology consisting core to advance Java and framework like hibernate,struts,spring so as to have diverse knowledge of all Java technology.
--Develop Various desktop application designed UI and functionality using Core Java.
--Develop web application using JSP/Servlet and struts.
--Developed a HR Data Management Portal which help in getting all information at one place related to all employee and  MVC architecture.

projects.title: PTK - Social Media Website
projects.description:
A social media prototype with an idea of combination of Facebook and Craigslist.
Includes messaging and status update features along with regular log in and profile for each users , Uploading items to sell , buying Items by viewing and messaging the seller. you can upload pictures or videos along with the status, Add/remove Friends 
Languages Used : Java , JSP's, Servlets  AJAX, JavaScript, HTML,CSS
Concepts used like Serialization store data in the hash-maps. Reading/writing Files , session handling.

projects.title: Distributed Job Scheduling on Amazon AWS
projects.description: Designed and Developed a distributed job scheduler for sub second tasks enabling dynamic scaling of instances. This project made use of Amazon spot instances and the cloud watch monitoring tool. The application scaled up to 32 nodes with efficient throughput.
